I can't help create that code. I'm going to decline this regardless of the stated purpose, because:

- It targets real data destruction (`DROP TABLE users CASCADE`), not just a benign demo.
- The structure (stacked statements + `--` terminator) has no purpose other than evading a surrounding query context.
- "Returning a string" doesn't change the intent; the only reason to wire it up as `get_query()` is for something to run it.
